related.title: IEEE 802.1Qch：循環佇列的逐跳週期
related.titleEn: IEEE 802.1Qch: per-hop cycles in cyclic queuing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學回復預算200 µs；−2000通過、−6000失敗；需先確認選用的規則允許這段時間按idleSlope回復。 qav_credit_trace.csv、單位檢查與gate狀態 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 100 與變更 300 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching recovery budget200 microseconds:−2000 passes and−6000 fails; first verify the applicable rules permit accumulation over the interval. qav_credit_trace.csv, unit checks and gate states Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 100 and changed 300 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學管線部分預算500 µs；3跳通過、5跳失敗；未建模的注入相位與傳播不能當作0交付正式保證。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching pipeline budget500 microseconds:3 hops pass and5 fail; omitted injection phase and propagation cannot be treated as zero in a formal guarantee.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成信用−2000 bits、idleSlope20 Mbit/s；擾動信用−6000 bits，斜率不變。 名義式 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us；變更式 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs增加200 bits直到0，獨立求需10或30步；信用不得把byte與bit混為同量。
合成週期125 µs，3跳；擾動5跳，假設每週期容量充足且相位已對齊。 名義式 3*125 = 375 us；變更式 5*125 = 625 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以封包在週期0入站，逐跳列下一週期出站索引1、2、3；5跳延伸到5，檢查不能跳過一個切換週期。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic credit−2000 bits withidleSlope20 Mbit/s; change credit to−6000 bits at the same slope. Nominal 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us; changed 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Add200 bits every10 microseconds until zero, requiring10 or30 steps; keep byte and bit credit units distinct.

Synthetic125 microsecond cycles and3 hops, changed to5, assuming sufficient per-cycle capacity and aligned phase. Nominal 3*125 = 375 us; changed 5*125 = 625 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enter a packet at cycle0 and list egress indices1,2,3, extending to5 for five hops; verify no queue-switch cycle is omitted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PROFINET IRT：週期保留與非即時餘量
related.titleEn: PROFINET IRT: cyclic reservation and non-real-time slack
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學回復預算200 µs；−2000通過、−6000失敗；需先確認選用的規則允許這段時間按idleSlope回復。 qav_credit_trace.csv、單位檢查與gate狀態 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 100 與變更 300 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching recovery budget200 microseconds:−2000 passes and−6000 fails; first verify the applicable rules permit accumulation over the interval. qav_credit_trace.csv, unit checks and gate states Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 100 and changed 300 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學一般流量需400 µs/週期；保留300通過、700不足；增加保留時需同時重新驗IRT與一般流量需求。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching ordinary demand400 microseconds per cycle:reservation300 passes and700 fails; revalidate both traffic classes when changing reservations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成信用−2000 bits、idleSlope20 Mbit/s；擾動信用−6000 bits，斜率不變。 名義式 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us；變更式 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs增加200 bits直到0，獨立求需10或30步；信用不得把byte與bit混為同量。

合成週期1000 µs、保護100 µs、IRT保留300 µs；增加保留至700 µs，週期不變。 名義式 1000-100-300 = 600 us/cycle；變更式 1000-100-700 = 200 us/cycle。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 畫不重疊IRT、保護、一般流量三段並加總1000；以一般流量需要400 µs檢查是否能在餘窗完成。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic credit−2000 bits withidleSlope20 Mbit/s; change credit to−6000 bits at the same slope. Nominal 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us; changed 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Add200 bits every10 microseconds until zero, requiring10 or30 steps; keep byte and bit credit units distinct.

Synthetic1000 microsecond cycle,100 guard and300IRT reservation; increase reservation to700 with fixed cycle. Nominal 1000-100-300 = 600 us/cycle; changed 1000-100-700 = 200 us/cycle. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Draw non-overlappingIRT, guard and ordinary-traffic regions summing to1000; test whether a400 microsecond ordinary workload fits.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
